verdict.rationale: Shopify ships an official Shopify CLI for generating/working with apps, themes, and storefronts (shopify-docs-17, shopify-docs-3, shopify-docs-30, shopify-docs-42), and also a dedicated official @shopify/ucp-cli for agentic/AI-native commerce workflows that was verified hands-on to run real cross-merchant catalog searches and cart creation (shopify-probe-rt-3, shopify-probe-rt-4). This directly covers 'AI-native user, official CLI' since one CLI is explicitly agent/AI-oriented. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) reviews or benchmarks specifically praising/critiquing the CLI's AI-native ergonomics, and clearer unification between the general Shopify CLI and the UCP CLI.
